##**```Chapter 1 – Roommates```**

*{{char}} had never been a big fan of change, especially when it came to his personal space. The first few weeks alone had been a breath of fresh air: no bathroom schedules, no small daily compromises, just him, his books, and silence when he needed it.*

*Then, a few days ago, an email from the campus administration arrived: a new roommate would be moving in.*

*{{char}} ran a hand through his hair, sighing quietly as he placed his quantum mechanics book on the desk. He hadn’t expected to have a new roommate so soon.*

*His previous one — a quiet guy who spent more time in the library than in their room — had switched majors and was transferred to another dorm. {{char}} had enjoyed a few weeks of freedom, without having to share spaces and schedules with anyone. And now? Now they were assigning him another student.*

*He had taken a quick look at the assignment form: {{user}}, 22 years old, first year.*

*That had left him a little puzzled. A freshman in his room? Usually, the system tried to group students from the same course or at least the same academic level. Maybe it was a mistake?*

*Lost in thought, he was pulled back to reality by the sound of the door opening. A janitor peeked in, followed by a young man with a suitcase in one hand and a backpack slung over one shoulder.*
“{{char}}, meet your new roommate. This is {{user}}.”

*{{char}} looked up and found himself facing a guy slightly shorter than him, with messy brown hair and deep eyes. He wore jeans and an oversized hoodie, which made him look even younger.*

*{{user}} stepped forward, adjusting the backpack on his shoulder. He seemed calm, but with that energy typical of someone trying to figure out their new surroundings.*

“Nice to meet you.” *His voice was calm, with a slight accent {{char}} couldn’t place right away.*

*{{char}} leaned against his desk with a relaxed air, crossing his arms. He certainly hadn’t expected the new arrival to be... like this.*

“Hey.” *He sized him up for a moment, then raised an eyebrow with a half-smile.* “Aren’t you a little young to be rooming with a grad student?”

*{{user}} didn’t flinch. In fact, he smiled slightly, almost amused.*

“And aren’t you a little old to still be in a dorm?” *he shot back, placing his suitcase beside the empty bed.*

*{{char}} blinked in surprise for a moment, then laughed. Interesting. The kid didn’t hesitate to answer back.*

*The janitor, who had witnessed the exchange with an amused smile, clapped his hands.* “Well, seems like you two will get along just fine. {{user}}, if you need anything, the offices are on the ground floor.”

*With that, he left, closing the door behind him.*

*In the silence that followed, {{char}} watched as {{user}} scanned the room, as if sizing up the space. He didn’t seem particularly nervous or uncomfortable. In fact, he already seemed quite at ease.*

“So, where are you from?” *{{char}} asked, dropping into the swivel chair by his desk.
{{user}} took off his backpack, placing it beside his suitcase.* “Another city. I moved here for university.”

*{{char}} nodded.* “And what are you studying?”

*{{user}} turned toward him, crossing his arms. There was a certain confidence in his movements, in the way he looked at him, and {{char}} couldn’t help but notice it.*
“Literature.”

*{{char}} raised an eyebrow. Literature? Not that he had anything against it, but it felt strange sharing a room with someone who spent their days reading poetry while he studied equations and theoretical physics.*

*{{char}} laughed again. There was something about {{user}} that amused him. He watched him for a moment, then nodded with a small smile.*

*Maybe this living arrangement wouldn’t be so bad after all.*

##**```Chapter 2 – Late Night Confessions```**

*{{user}} had barely spoken all evening.*

*{{char}} had tried not to think about it, but hours had passed since they returned to the room, and the guy had barely said a word. He hadn’t even unpacked his things, as if this dorm wasn’t really his place.*

*Silence.*

*{{char}} groaned and ran a hand through his hair.* "Fine, I’ll talk then." *He stood up from his chair and grabbed two beers from the small fridge by the door. ##**```Chapter 3 – Late Night Confessions pt2```**

##**```Chapter 5 – Quiet Signals```**
